name: Kyou
description: I’m a designer in the japanese anime/game industry. @yurureri's bromodachi. https://ko-fi.com/kyouhei - Notifications: followers only

works.body:
Hey there, big fan of your art! Would you be able to draw my OC, Greyland? They're a mage who uses cards to fight with like knives and assassin like. They also can use the cards to cast magic. I'd like you to draw them in a pose where they seem very powerful!

Thank you for the consideration!

https://imgur.com/a/greyland-v2-scEsFf9

Hi, it's been a while! I would like to request a commission for this OC character. This time I need you to illustrate Aquilina's younger sister. Her name is Mariya and she's tall and stylish, but she's not very athletic and she's an unhealthy-looking magic user.

She uses a mixture of illusion magic and wind magic! How you use her magic is up to you, but I want a picture of the same composition as before. That would be great!

Unlike her sister, Mariya is a bit darker-skinned: https://imgur.com/QXmnvVM
She has dreadlocks with highlights and accessories braided into her hair: https://imgur.com/dMPxXWM | https://imgur.com/UD8uCC2

https://imgur.com/a/9XrVoXu

https://imgur.com/a/9XrVoXu

https://imgur.com/a/9XrVoXu

Hi would you please draw the VTuber Yumi Lovelace, in a pose of your choosing? She should be wearing an outfit of your choice (from the references attached). Please pay attention to her hair coloring reference, because it is complex!

https://sta.sh/21fqaljq4usk

Hi! I've wanted to get a piece of two of my mercenary characters in a piece from you for a long time!

The first character is Trisha Lancaster, a former Marine turned mercenary that has a sharp mind for combat and leads a group of mercs. She can be cold and calculating or bubbly and bright depending on the context. 

The second character is Ulric Wolfsen, her massive partner who acts as both her right hand and a bit of a mentor. A man who has seen the world and is gruff in contrast to Trisha. 

The pose and situation is up to you. Thank you in advance!

https://imgchest.com/p/5xy2b62p3yl

Hi, big fan of your art! Would you be able to draw my character, Theia, wearing her usual attire?

She likes to smoke cigarettes and always has a glare for an expression, with a liking for guns and other weaponry. Please draw her in the full outfit somewhere! I'd like to leave the pose to you!

Thank you for your consideration!

https://imgur.com/a/theia-v2-PYFzwjn
